<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="104" fill="#F5C418"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="27" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">9:41</text>
    <line x1="326" y1="23" x2="326" y2="27" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="21" x2="331" y2="27" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="19" x2="336" y2="27" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="341" y1="17" x2="341" y2="27" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="354" cy="23" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="351" y1="20" x2="357" y2="26" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <rect x="367" y="18" width="18" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <rect x="369" y="20" width="13" height="6" rx="1" fill="#333333"/>
    <rect x="385" y="21" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#333333"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="57" width="54" height="31" rx="4" fill="#333333"/>
    <text x="47" y="80" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="23" font-weight="700" fill="#F5C418">IMDb</text>
    <text x="94" y="77" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#333333">Reset password</text>
    <line x1="350" y1="69" x2="370" y2="69" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="350" y1="75" x2="370" y2="75" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="350" y1="81" x2="370" y2="81" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Main content -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="143" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Create a new password</text>
    <text x="24" y="169" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Choose a strong password to keep your account secure.</text>

    <text x="24" y="211" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">New password</text>
    <rect x="23" y="222" width="344" height="54" rx="8" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="20" y="219" width="344" height="54" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="37" y="252" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">••••••••••••</text>
    <g>
      <ellipse cx="337" cy="245" rx="12" ry="8" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <circle cx="337" cy="245" r="3" fill="#646F79"/>
      <line x1="326" y1="235" x2="348" y2="255" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    </g>

    <text x="24" y="298" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Use 8 or more characters with a mix of letters and numbers.</text>
    <rect x="24" y="310" width="250" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <rect x="24" y="310" width="175" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#40C173"/>
    <text x="284" y="317" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#40C173">Good</text>

    <text x="24" y="361" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Confirm new password</text>
    <rect x="23" y="372" width="344" height="54" rx="8" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="20" y="369" width="344" height="54" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="37" y="402" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">••••••••••••</text>
    <g>
      <ellipse cx="337" cy="395" rx="12" ry="8" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <circle cx="337" cy="395" r="3" fill="#646F79"/>
      <line x1="326" y1="385" x2="348" y2="405" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    </g>

    <g>
      <rect x="20" y="460" width="344" height="50" rx="8" fill="#000000" opacity="0.10"/>
      <rect x="20" y="457" width="344" height="50" rx="8" fill="#F2C94C"/>
      <text x="192" y="488" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#333333">Continue</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="20" y="523" width="344" height="50" rx="8" fill="#333333"/>
      <polyline points="151,548 145,543 151,538" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="196" y="554" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Back</text>
    </g>

    <line x1="24" y1="622" x2="366" y2="622" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="650" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">By continuing, you agree to IMDb's</text>
    <text x="195" y="671" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Conditions of Use</text>
    <text x="195" y="693" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">and acknowledge the</text>
    <text x="195" y="714" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Privacy Notice</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="774" width="390" height="70" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,797 49,789 59,797" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="42" y="796" width="14" height="12" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="49" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="142" cy="798" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="148" y1="804" x2="154" y2="810" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="143" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Search</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <polyline points="235,791 243,794 251,791 251,808 243,804 235,808 235,791" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="243" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Wishlist</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="334" cy="795" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="334" cy="807" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="334" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
